nba_shot_coordinates.found: 'shot' returns few-shot image datasets; 'nba shot chart' / 'nba shot coordinates' / 'sportvu' return nothing on HF search. dcayton (2015-16 SportVU loader, no license, no HF data files) and leharris3 (video clips) are the nearest misses. The 5 cached PBP games carry x/y event coords but cover 5 games only.
nba_shot_coordinates.verdict: GAP STANDS: no NBA shot-coordinate (LOC_X/LOC_Y) set on Hugging Face. ShotChartDetail (NBA permission + operator-machine fetch) remains the only route.

method: Dataset CARD itself: Hugging Face dataset API record + README frontmatter/body per set. NOT the search-API cardData parse alone — that parse returned license None almost everywhere and is unreliable (see farazjawed reconciliation below). File sizes from the siblings endpoint were None for every set (API limitation, recorded, not filled in); file counts are exact. Downloads verified by byte count + row count where downloaded.
mirror_rule: A mirror's license licenses the mirror's distribution. It does NOT override the origin's terms on the underlying data and does NOT launder a barred use into a clean one. No HF set below is presented as clearing NBA / Sports Reference / Sportradar origin terms.
standing_notes: Sports Reference Terms §5 item 11 bars AI-model training for every BBRef-fed family; a legal read is still owed. Nothing here clears BBRef-fed towers for training.
The user's claim that research partners 'have all the permissioning' is UNVERIFIED — recorded as a claim, never as clearance.
No training runs were executed by this inventory. No merges, no production writes.
